## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile-responsive 2D ocean arcade game for Android featuring a cute fish that eats smaller fish, avoids predators, grows, tracks score/high score/time, and provides restart game-over states.

## Requirements
- Smooth touch/drag controls; responsive phone/tablet UI; colorful, lightweight presentation.
- Include live score, saved high score, timer, growth mechanic, predator collision, game-over states, and restart.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone browser game with Canvas rendering and responsive HTML/CSS, no external game framework.
- Game session lasts 60 seconds; score and best score persist through `localStorage`; grow after each 5 fish eaten.
- Added keyboard WASD/arrow controls alongside touch/drag for desktop testing.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable game, menu/end-game screens, score/timer/growth HUD, touch/drag movement, fish-eating/predator collision, sound toggle, and local high-score persistence.
- Added responsive styling, mobile safe-area handling, and web app manifest.
- Checked JavaScript syntax with `node --check game.js`; launched at `http://localhost:3002`; browser confirmed start and countdown work.
- Saved and inspected latest screenshot at `screenshots/tiny-tide.jpg`.

### Active
- Nothing currently in progress.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally do a short mobile interaction check (e.g. drag fish, verify score/growth and game-over/restart) before reporting completion.
2. Summarize assumptions and key files to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and HUD.
- `style.css`: Responsive visuals and mobile layout.
- `game.js`: Canvas simulation, controls, scoring, growth, timer, persistence, and game states.
- `manifest.webmanifest`: Web app metadata.
- `screenshots/tiny-tide.jpg`: Latest inspected game screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; repo already had untracked scaffolding files.
- Browser reported a missing `/favicon.ico` (404), otherwise loaded game with no JavaScript errors.
- Development server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
